License: MIT

## What it does

AGENTS.md Repo Readiness Checker is a free, no-signup, browser-only checklist tool for pasted AGENTS.md drafts. It scores whether a repository instruction file gives coding agents enough context to work safely: setup, exact commands, project map, conventions, verification, PR guidance, boundaries, and maintenance cues.

## Privacy posture

The checker runs locally in the browser. It does not send pasted Markdown anywhere, does not require login, does not use analytics scripts, and does not use browser storage.
